note: Success criteria fixed before any detection results existed. The floor baseline is learned from previous nights' sweeps (per-cell median of up to 3 nights); nothing is trained.

criteria.text: Toys found, of those the sweep observed
Small flat items found (Lego, tissue, string, sock, paper)
Known stains flagged as new clutter
Removed items flagged as still there
Night 3 rug flagged as a floor change, not clutter

amendment: Added sock and paper to the small-flat-items group; held-out evaluation = nights 5-8 of the same house, detector frozen after tuning on nights 1-4. Still before any detection results.

difficulty.rule: easy: >= 100 cm2 footprint and colour contrast with the floor under it >= 0.25; hard: < 15 cm2, string thinner than 3 mm, or contrast < 0.10; medium: everything else. Computed from each item's own properties, before any results.
difficulty.report: Found rate per tier, per night, and pooled over held-out nights 5-8.
